nodes.name: Mooch The Envious
nodes.desc:
Summons /c Mooch c/, an alien parasite of pure /c Envy c/. 

He autonomously devours your /c Zek c/ to build a massive internal multiplier. Slash his limbs to trim his mass, or strip him down completely to layer zero to slay him and extract his hoarded /c NV c/.

nodes.name: Moo The Baby
nodes.desc:
Upon slaying a Mooch, a /c Moo c/ is born from the corpse. 

This *dumb, slow creature* wanders the board, devouring loose crystals to grow a segmented tail. 

Once it reaches **capacity**, it detonates into a multiplied /c ZEK c/ payout. It's not smart. It's just *happy to be here*.

nodes.name: Hungry Baby
nodes.desc:
Babies grow up so fast, don't they?

Increases the maximum number of crystals a Moo can ingest before bursting to /v. 

A longer tail means a **higher base value** when it finally pops. *The numbers go up.*

nodes.name: A Brain Cell

The Moo gains *spatial awareness*. 

It actively reads the player's cursor trajectory , calculating pathfinding to **avoid stealing crystals** from your active operator chains. 

*Training your pet not to bite the hand that feeds it.*

nodes.name: Cannibalism
nodes.desc:
**Swarm coordination unlocked.** 

If multiple Moos are alive, a smaller Moo will actively hunt down the tail of a larger Moo to *consume it*, fusing their segments into one **massive, exponentially multiplied super-chain** before detonating.

nodes.name: Singularity
nodes.desc:
The ultimate *hive-mind evolution*. 

Moos will no longer detonate at max capacity. Instead, they enter a **charged state** and seek out your active Operator chain.

When you claim your chain, all charged Moos snap to the end, pooling their entire devoured mass into your final /c Sum(Weights)² c/ calculation.
